verdict: Organic search is holding; paid channels and outreach pipeline remain paused.
narrative: Across all three businesses this period, every measurable touchpoint came from Google Business Profile — a combined 382 actions (directions, web clicks, and calls) over 28 days, with no paid spend active on any entity. GBP engagement is softening heading into the final days of the window: Advance Grinding Services posted two consecutive zero-action days, and O'Hare Precision Metals saw a 37.5% week-over-week decline; these trends are being watched closely. On the O'Hare side, two profiles — Precision Ground Bars and Precision Ground Metals — recorded zero calls despite active impressions, and the call tracking on both is being corrected now. Several foundational milestones needed to launch outreach and paid acquisition — including contact list pulls, CRM data reconciliation, and a Web/SEO root-cause fix — are overdue and being prioritized; once these are cleared, the paid and outreach channels can go live. Next period, the focus is resolving those blockers so the businesses are no longer dependent on organic alone.

paid ad spend this period — all activity is organic

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement is declining across Advance Grinding Services and O'Hare in the final days of the period, while two profiles show zero calls despite visible search impressions.
watch_item.fix: Call tracking on the affected profiles is being corrected, and the Web/SEO and contact-list blockers that are holding back paid and outreach channels are being escalated this week.
